messages.content: Let's settle the Boston dates before we look at hotels. The family celebration is Saturday, January 23. Compare leaving Chicago Thursday evening versus Friday morning, and coming back Monday evening versus Tuesday morning. Three travelers, and don't book anything.

I’ll compare all four combinations from Chicago to Boston for January 21-26, including airfare for three, time on the ground, missed school or work, and the hotel-night count. Are you treating Friday and Monday as available vacation days, or should I count each absence separately?

Count them separately. Owen can miss Friday or Monday, but I don't want him missing both. Daniel and I can each absorb one workday. Tuesday morning would mean Owen gets to school late, not a full missed day.

That removes the Friday-to-Monday combination if you want four nights, since it is only three hotel nights. The realistic four-night patterns are Thursday evening to Monday evening and Friday morning to Tuesday morning. A Thursday-to-Tuesday trip is possible but adds a fifth hotel night and causes the most disruption.
Give me the actual flight choices and totals for those two realistic patterns. Include the best mixed option too, just so I can see whether the extra night buys us anything.

For Thursday January 21 to Monday January 25, the strongest nonstop pairing is United ORD-BOS 6:10-9:29 p.m. and BOS-ORD 6:35-8:29 p.m. Economy is $1,047 total for three. You get all day Friday through most of Monday in Boston, Owen misses Friday and Monday, and the stay is four nights.

For Friday January 22 to Tuesday January 26, JetBlue departs ORD at 8:05 a.m. and arrives BOS at 11:23 a.m.; the return leaves at 7:10 a.m. and reaches ORD at 9:13 a.m. The total is $936 for three. You lose Friday morning in Boston, but Owen misses only Friday and can reach school around late morning Tuesday. This is also four hotel nights.

The useful five-night comparison is Thursday evening outbound with the Tuesday morning return. Using those same United and JetBlue legs totals $1,002 for three. It gives you the most Boston time, but Owen misses Friday and part of Tuesday, while you and Daniel each need Friday plus part of Tuesday away from work.
Is there a later Tuesday return? Seven in the morning defeats the point of staying Monday night.

Yes. American has a nonstop Tuesday departure at 10:20 a.m., arriving ORD at 12:31 p.m. Paired with the Friday 8:05 a.m. JetBlue outbound, the three-person total is $987. Owen would likely miss most of Tuesday rather than arriving late, so that version creates two affected school days. A 9:15 a.m. United return arrives at 11:24 a.m. and brings the package to $1,041, with the same practical school impact.

Then keep the early return. Between Thursday evening and Friday morning, I prefer the morning departure when the schedule leaves us a real choice. Does Friday morning still get us enough cushion for Saturday?

Yes. The Friday flight lands at 11:23 a.m., leaving roughly 24 hours before a Saturday midday celebration and more if the event is later. Even allowing for winter delays, Friday gives you a reasonable buffer; Thursday is safer only if weather risk is severe enough to justify another school absence and the higher fare.
What is the usable-time difference, not just the clock times? Assume we can reach either Chicago airport normally and the celebration starts at 2:00 Saturday.

Thursday-Monday provides about 87 usable Boston hours: hotel arrival near 10:30 p.m. Thursday through departure for Logan around 4:30 p.m. Monday. Friday-Tuesday provides about 66 usable hours: hotel arrival around 12:30 p.m. Friday through departure around 5:15 a.m. Tuesday. The Thursday pattern buys roughly 21 hours, mostly Friday morning and Monday evening. Both leave ample margin before the 2:00 p.m. Saturday celebration.

The extra 21 hours aren't worth Owen missing Monday too. Choose Friday January 22 through Tuesday January 26, with the 8:05 outbound and 7:10 return. No booking yet. Carry the fares and four hotel nights into the hotel search.

Selected, not booked: Friday January 22 through Tuesday January 26, four hotel nights. JetBlue ORD-BOS departs 8:05 a.m. Friday and arrives 11:23 a.m.; JetBlue BOS-ORD departs 7:10 a.m. Tuesday and arrives 9:13 a.m. Airfare is currently $936 total for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen. Plan on reaching the Boston hotel around 12:30 p.m. Friday and leaving for Logan around 5:15 a.m. Tuesday. Owen misses Friday and should reach school late Tuesday morning; Marcus and Daniel each use Friday as the principal workday away. The Saturday 2:00 p.m. celebration remains fixed. I’ll use these dates, times, airfare, and the four-night requirement for the lodging comparison.
